description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Holy with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Knight Mode I (Beatrix)] and [Knight Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Knight Mode I (Beatrix)
description.text: Knight abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Knight abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00 for Knight abilities, casts Dual Seiken after using Knight abilities (max 1)

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)], grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Knight Mode II (Beatrix)] to the user, removes [Dual Awoken Knight Mode I (Beatrix)] from the user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Knight Mode II (Beatrix)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 20000, Knight abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Knight abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Dual Climhazzard after using Knight abilities

description.name: Dual Climhazzard
description.text: 4/5/6 single attacks (0.59 each) scaling with uses, 100% hit rate

description.name: Dual Seiken
description.text: Three single attacks (1.02 each), 100% hit rate, grants [100% Critical 3] to the user

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3
